name: Avenger Of Blood
overview: The concept of the Avenger of Blood in Scripture underscores God's justice in requiring accountability for the shedding of human life, as seen in Genesis 9:6 where man is made in God's image and thus the taking of life demands retribution. Early examples include Cain, who feared for his life after killing Abel, prompting God to set a protective mark on him to prevent his death at the hands of others (Genesis 4:14-15). The law further established the role of a designated avenger who was authorized to execute judgment on a murderer (Numbers 35:19), though this legal provision was later set aside by David. The severity of vengeance is also reflected in Lamech's declaration of seventy-sevenfold retribution (Genesis 4:24), highlighting the seriousness with which bloodshed was regarded under God's order.
